text:
anya: Quick one 1: our hello-docker quickstart still shows env var usage inline in Dockerfile (e.g., `ENV REDWOOD_API_TOKEN`) and a manual curl example. We now prefer `REDWOOD_API_KEY` and `RedwoodClient.from_env()` so users don't bake secrets into images. Can we refresh this doc?

Tom: +1. I spotted it during onboarding session. Plan: update Dockerfile snippet to read from runtime env and add a small `entrypoint.sh` example for injecting the key at deploy. I can take the Docker pieces.

lee: I'll handle the code snippets in Go + Python. Also want to add a short security note about not committing `.env` files. Maybe a blurb and a link to our secrets guide.

rachel: I'll do the screenshots and the deploy section (Heroku -> Cloud Run). Heads up: one screenshot link is 404 after the repo reorg. I'll replace it and compress.

anya: proposed Dockerfile snippet (will PR):
```Dockerfile
FROM python:3.11-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
# do NOT set REDWOOD_API_KEY at build time
CMD ["/app/entrypoint.sh"]
```

entrypoint.sh suggestion:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
if [ -z "$REDWOOD_API_KEY" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: REDWOOD_API_KEY not set"
  exit 1
fi
exec python main.py
```

Tom: nice. For the runtime snippet we should show `RedwoodClient.from_env()` and a tiny smoke test endpoint. I'll add Node + Python examples.

lee: Python example to show safe usage:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient.from_env()  # reads REDWOOD_API_KEY
resp = client.chat.generate("hi")
print(resp.text)
```

lee: Node example:
```js
import { RedwoodClient } from 'redwood'
const client = RedwoodClient.fromEnv()
const r = await client.chat.generate({ input: 'hello' })
console.log(r.output)
```

rachel: screenshot work done, alt text added: "Quickstart dashboard showing successful deploy and smoke test response". Replaced missing image with compressed `hello-docker-deploy.png`.

anya: also adding a short CI note: our docs CI flagged the quickstart link to the starter repo. I updated the target to `github.com/redwood/hello-starter` and added a redirect note for older forks. build-bot: can you run linkcheck?

build-bot: docs CI started for PR #4332 by anya. Linkcheck: 0 broken links. linter: one markdown heading style fixed by commit 2.

Tom: can someone review the security blurb? Suggested wording: "Never bake secrets into images. Use runtime envs or secret managers (see link)." Also add an example of Cloud Run secret env injection.

lee: LGTM on wording. I'll add a short example for `gcloud` to set env var from secret: `gcloud run services update SERVICE --update-secrets REDWOOD_API_KEY=projects/PROJECT/secrets/REDWOOD_API_KEY:latest`

rachel: small layout tweak: move the auth section above deploy steps so users add keys before they hit the deploy command. Saves confusion.

anya: thanks. I'm opening the PR now with all snippets + screenshot + CI fixes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4332. Targeting merge today for the evening docs publish.

build-bot: PR #4332 opened by anya. CI: running.

anya: once merged, I'll add a short migration note in the quickstart index: "If you upgraded from SDK v5, rename env var REDWOOD_API_TOKEN -> REDWOOD_API_KEY and replace client initializers with RedwoodClient.from_env()". Will assign @tom for final review.

Tom: happy to sign off after CI green. :+1:

build-bot: CI passed. Merge scheduled at 18:00 UTC.

anya: awesome, thanks y'all. Closing thread after merge.
